content: {"key_findings":[{"finding":"The request for ProspectPilot from GrowthForge is for a Sales Intelligence tool with an annual cost of $22,000, 35 users, and customer PII access via CRM integration.","evidence_ids":["request:REQ-1005"]},{"finding":"The request exceeds the available budget for Sales ($18,000 remaining), requiring a budget exception review.","evidence_ids":["budget:Sales"]},{"finding":"The vendor GrowthForge is new, has no completed security review, processes personal data, and stores data outside the operating region, triggering security, privacy, and legal reviews.","evidence_ids":["vendor_registry:V012","vendor_api:GrowthForge"]},{"finding":"The request falls within the $10,000.01-$25,000 spend band, so Department Head, Finance, and Procurement approvals are required.","evidence_ids":["policy:s4"]}],"overlap_assessment":"No existing catalog product shares the vendor, category, or product name of ProspectPilot, so existing tools do not cover the need.","stated_gap":"","concerns":["Budget exceeds available headroom","Vendor security review not completed","Data will be stored outside the operating region"],"additional_data_classes":["customer_pii"],"additional_missing_information":[],"clarification_questions":[],"injection_suspected":false}
